title: Rethinking the game development and character animation using AI! wdyt?
author: PDeperson

comments.author: PDeperson
comments.body:
The way we do character animation in game development is evolving. I've been rethinking this process with a focus on simplicity and low cost, using AI motion capture as the core tool. That’s what led to Human Motion Masters, a project built to demonstrate what’s possible without breaking the bank.

I'll reveal how it all works very soon. In the meantime, check out the project here:
